dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
いただきますをして、まさに箸を持ったところ
で、音夢が小さく声をあげた。
dialogues.en:
We were just about ready to dig in, chopsticks in hand, when
Nemu let out a quiet exclamation.
dialogues.text:
We were just about ready to dig in, chopsticks in hand, when
Nemu let out a quiet exclamation.

dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What's up?"
dialogues.text: "What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……しょう油、買ってくるの忘れた」
dialogues.en: "...I forgot to buy the soy sauce."
dialogues.text: "...I forgot to buy the soy sauce."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「にゃにい？」
dialogues.en: "Whaaat?"
dialogues.text: "Whaaat?"

dialogues.jp:
黙って、テーブルに目を遣る。今夜は、スー
パーで買ってきたお刺身の盛り合わせだった。
dialogues.en:
I silently stared at the table. We had went to the
supermarket to buy sashimi for tonight's dinner.
dialogues.text:
I silently stared at the table. We had went to the
supermarket to buy sashimi for tonight's dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ま、まあ、いいですよね。ほら、付け合わせ
　のものがあるし」
dialogues.en: "W, well, it's okay. We can eat other things."
dialogues.text: "W, well, it's okay. We can eat other things."

dialogues.jp:
緑色したビニールの、しょう油入れをつまみ上
げる。
dialogues.en: Nemu put the green vinyl soy sauce bottle back down.
dialogues.text: Nemu put the green vinyl soy sauce bottle back down.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、なあ……けど、それ、量が少なすぎな
　いか？」
dialogues.en: "Well, but... it'd be quite a waste..."
dialogues.text: "Well, but... it'd be quite a waste..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「言われてみれば……」
dialogues.en: "That's true..."
dialogues.text: "That's true..."

dialogues.jp: 刺身の量に比べて、いかにも頼りないのだ。
dialogues.en:
The sashimi just lay there, practically crying out to be
bathed in the black stuff.
dialogues.text:
The sashimi just lay there, practically crying out to be
bathed in the black stuff.

dialogues.jp:
「途中でなくなったら、かなりかったるい状況
　になるな……」
dialogues.en:
"It's really out of the way too, getting some more soy sauce
would be troublesome..."
dialogues.text:
"It's really out of the way too, getting some more soy sauce
would be troublesome..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ま、いいじゃない。塩分控えめだと思えば。
　何事も前向きですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's okay. Look on the bright side, we can still put
salt on it."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's okay. Look on the bright side, we can still put
salt on it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「前向き、ねえ……」
dialogues.en: "The bright side, huh..."
dialogues.text: "The bright side, huh..."

dialogues.jp:
前向きなのはいいが、何にしろ、しょう油なし
で刺身が食えるほど、俺はグルメじゃない。
dialogues.en:
The bright side aside, even a non-gourmet like me can tell
that nothing goes well with sashimi except soy sauce.
dialogues.text:
The bright side aside, even a non-gourmet like me can tell
that nothing goes well with sashimi except soy sauce.

dialogues.en: "Hmmm..."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm..."

dialogues.jp: どうしようかな……
dialogues.en: What should I do...
dialogues.text: What should I do...

dialogues.jp: ◆おしょうゆ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Soy Sauce◆
dialogues.text: ◆Soy Sauce◆

dialogues.jp:
お刺身をおかずにした夕ご飯。けれど、肝心の
しょう油を忘れてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Sashimi was the main dish of tonight's dinner, but the
essential condiment of soy sauce was forgotten.
dialogues.text:
Sashimi was the main dish of tonight's dinner, but the
essential condiment of soy sauce was forgotten.

choices.en: ○Better go and buy some soy sauce...
choices.text: ○Better go and buy some soy sauce...
